name: memo
title: Memo
description: A one- or two-page memo in Markdown, rendered by Pandoc through Typst to PDF: a title block, a summary, a list of highlights, and the template's own Markdown. The values reach the PDF through raw Typst (`#summary`); Markdown carries the rest.

sample.title: Quarterly kitchen review
sample.author: Operations
sample.summary: Waste fell for the third quarter running, and the new morning bake covers the early rush without a second oven.
highlights: Waste down from 12 % to 5 % of the daily bake
Two bakes a day instead of one
A written waste log at every closing
